_comment: 规格 352 P3 试点：21 条工具的定义改写（英文）。
★ 写法：首句 = <动词> <对象> <关键限定>，≤120 字符、不用中文句号、不带 ★ 元数据；
第二/三句 = 何时用 / 前置 / 副作用 / 返回什么；整段 ≤600 字符。
★ 参数说明：<它是什么>[; <取值域>][; defaults to <默认值>].（句号必须）
★ 每条都只压缩 `evidence` 或目标函数 docstring 里已有的事实 —— 不新增语义。

solidworks_macro_build_prompt.doc: Build the prompt that asks a model to write SolidWorks VBA for user_request. Internal step of the sw_macro_guard generate_macro_with_guard pipeline, not meant to be called on its own; it is a pure string function and never calls SolidWorks.

params.user_request: What the user wants the macro to do, in natural language.
params.model_name: Model name mapped onto a prompt family by solidworks_macro_normalize_model_family; empty means the generic family. Defaults to empty.
params.strict: Whether to emit the strict variant of the prompt. Defaults to true.

solidworks_macro_extract_vba_code.doc: Pull the VBA source out of a model reply that mixes prose and code fences. Internal step of the sw_macro_guard generate_macro_with_guard pipeline; pure text handling, no SolidWorks call. Feed the result to solidworks_macro_validate_vba_code before anything runs.

params.text: Raw model output, which may contain prose and Markdown code fences around the code.

solidworks_macro_fallback_template.doc: Return the local fallback VBA template for user_request, used when model generation fails. Internal step of the sw_macro_guard generate_macro_with_guard pipeline; pure function with no SolidWorks call and no network access.

params.user_request: The user's request text, used to pick the closest template.

solidworks_macro_normalize_model_family.doc: Map a concrete model name onto one of the prompt families this repo uses (gpt, kimi, claude, generic). Internal step of the sw_macro_guard generate_macro_with_guard pipeline; pure string function with no SolidWorks call and no COM.

params.model_name: Model name exactly as written by the caller, for example gpt-4o or claude-3.5-sonnet.

solidworks_macro_select_template.doc: Choose the local VBA template whose keywords match user_request. Internal step of the sw_macro_guard generate_macro_with_guard pipeline; pure function, and the template bodies live in this repo under the MIT licence.

params.user_request: The user's request text, matched against template keywords.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_edge_flang.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: pywin32 cannot reach the process-internal pointers the official call needs. It would create an edge flange on one selected edge and write a feature into the active part without saving it.

params.selection: Declarative EDGE selection: '__current_selection__' to reuse the current selection, or 'index:<n>' for the n-th edge on the body.
params.bend_radius_mm: Bend radius in millimetres; ignored when use_default_radius is true.
params.angle_deg: Flange angle in degrees. Defaults to 90.
params.use_default_radius: Whether to use the part default bend radius instead of bend_radius_mm. Defaults to true.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to flip which side the flange grows from. Defaults to false.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_gusset.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: ISMGussetFeatureData needs process-internal pointers and creates no feature. Every property writes back, which hides the failure.

params.selection: Declarative FACE selection: '__current_selection__' or 'index:<n>' for the n-th face on the body.
params.profile_distance_1_mm: First leg length of the gusset profile in millimetres.
params.profile_distance_2_mm: Second leg length of the gusset profile in millimetres. Defaults to 0.
params.profile_angle_deg: Angle of the gusset profile in degrees. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_one_bend.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: bend-line and fixed-face selection is still unsolved. The CreateDefinition(35) sketch-bend entry point itself is correct, so nothing is written to the part.

params.sketch_name: Name of the sketch holding the bend line; '__current_selection__' reuses the current selection.
params.bend_radius_mm: Bend radius in millimetres; ignored when use_default_radius is true.
params.reverse_direction: Whether to flip the bend direction. Defaults to false.
params.use_default_radius: Whether to use the part default bend radius instead of bend_radius_mm. Defaults to true.

solidworks_assembly_component_pattern_re.doc: List the assembly feature tree node by node, including any component-pattern nodes. Read-only, and it reports the whole tree rather than isolating pattern readings: there is no dedicated pattern-count measurement behind it.

params.include_subfeatures: Whether to descend into sub-features while walking the tree. Defaults to true.

solidworks_assembly_iter_feature_tree.doc: List the assembly feature tree node by node, covering components, features and mates. Read-only. Use solidworks_assembly_list_components instead when you only need the component list.

solidworks_assembly_performance_analysis.doc: Summarise the mates and features of the active assembly as per-item counts. Read-only; it reports real counts read from the mate group and feature tree, not a call to an official performance-analysis member.

solidworks_assembly_sequence_report.doc: Report the assembly components as ordered rows that read like an assembly instruction sheet. Read-only; it is built from the real bills-of-materials rows, and SolidWorks has no member that produces an assembly sequence.

params.include_excluded: Whether to include components excluded from the bill of materials. Defaults to false.

solidworks_available_direction_selectors.doc: List the direction-selector names usable when specifying geometry. Read-only and needs no open document; pass one of the returned names wherever a tool takes a direction selector.

solidworks_available_point_selectors.doc: List the point-selector names usable when specifying geometry. Read-only and needs no open document; pass one of the returned names wherever a tool takes a point selector.

solidworks_catalog_contract.doc: Read the full contract of one tool from the catalog: name, domain, parameters, availability and preconditions. Read-only; omit tool_name to get the catalog summary instead of a single card.

params.tool_name: Canonical tool name such as solidworks_extrude_boss; empty returns the catalog summary. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_catalog_domains.doc: List the eight task domains and the seven controlled multi-labels used to classify tools. Read-only; use the returned domain names as the domain filter of solidworks_catalog_retrieve.

solidworks_catalog_exposure.doc: Report which tools a given exposure mode would present to the model. Read-only; autonomous mode keeps only planning entry points and the necessary query tools, compat mode keeps every tool.

params.mode: Exposure mode: 'autonomous' for planning entry points plus query tools, or 'compat' for every tool. Defaults to 'compat'.

solidworks_catalog_retrieve.doc: Search the tool catalog by free text and facets and return the matching tool cards. Read-only; every filter is optional and an omitted filter means no restriction on that facet.

params.query: Natural-language query in Chinese or English; empty means no text filter. Defaults to empty.
params.domain: Task domain to restrict to; see solidworks_catalog_domains for the valid names. Defaults to empty.
params.doc_state: Required document state to restrict to, for example an open document or a selection. Defaults to empty.
params.backend: Backend reachability to restrict to, for example com_pywin32 or file_io. Defaults to empty.
params.capability: Availability label to restrict to. Defaults to empty.
params.budget: Upper bound on candidate tokens returned. Defaults to 4096.

solidworks_circular_pattern.doc: Create a circular pattern of one feature about an axis. Writes a pattern feature into the active part and does not save the document; count counts the instances including the seed, and the total angle is spread over equal spacing when that is enabled.

params.feature_name: Name of the feature to pattern, as it appears in the feature tree.
params.axis_name: Name of the axis or circular edge to revolve around.
params.count: Number of instances including the seed feature.
params.equal_spacing: Whether to space the instances equally across the angle. Defaults to true.

solidworks_export_flat_pattern_dxf.doc: Export the sheet-metal flat pattern of the active part to a DXF file for cutting. Writes the file, and refuses to run unless the part is already saved or allow_temporary_save is true.

params.include_bend_lines: Whether to write the bend lines. Defaults to true.
params.include_sketches: Whether to write the sketches. Defaults to false.
params.include_hidden_edges: Whether to write hidden edges. Defaults to false.
params.include_bounding_box: Whether to write the bounding box. Defaults to false.
params.merge_coplanar_faces: Whether to merge coplanar faces. Defaults to false.
params.allow_temporary_save: Whether to save the unsaved part into temporary_save_dir first so the official precondition holds. Defaults to false, which keeps the previous behaviour.
params.temporary_save_dir: Directory for that temporary save; must stay inside this repository. Defaults to output/_temp_save.

solidworks_section_properties.doc: Read the section properties of the current selection. Not read-only: the official member clears and rewrites the selection set, and the returned area unit is unverified, so treat it as a number without a unit.
